messages:
nina_sales: AuroraHealth wants a 2-week POC and sent a short network questionnaire. They need recommendation: PrivateLink vs VPC peering, installer access (bastion vs SSM), minimal firewall allowlist, and a simple line-item estimate for PrivateLink in the SOW.

omar_neteng: PrivateLink preferred for cross-account isolation and when customers prohibit route table changes. Peering ok for same-account, low-latency VPCs. If cross-region, neither works natively (need multi-endpoint + smart routing).

paul_deploy: Installer: we support unattended HTTPS installer and prefer SSM Session Manager for ephemeral access. No permanent bastion required. If customer forbids SSM, request a time-bound bastion with strict SGs.

tia_sec: Security checklist to return: no inbound 0.0.0.0/0 to service subnets, enable VPC Flow Logs to their collector, restrict PrivateLink endpoint policy to their account IDs, and require TLS for control-plane traffic.

lina_ae: Pricing for SOW: include onboarding fee, AWS Interface Endpoint hourly (~$0.01-$0.03/hr region-dependent), data processing per-GB (~$0.01/GB), and our POC support hours. Add a note: these are estimates and AWS billable rates may vary.

omar_neteng: Minimal firewall snippet to share: 
- Allow outbound TCP 443 to: 34.198.12.0/24, 52.23.89.0/24 (Redwood control plane)
- If using PrivateLink: allow access to ENI IPs created by the interface endpoint (AWS manages)
- Avoid opening SSH (22); prefer SSM.

tia_sec: TLS-inspect note: if they terminate/inspect TLS, call out SNI passthrough or recommend PrivateLink + end-to-end TLS. Also ask for log retention window and KMS/HSM requirements.

deploybot: Template: templates/privatedeploy/aws/poc_minimal.yaml. Run `./deploy.sh --account <acct> --region <region>` after cross-account role is created.

paul_deploy: Handoff checklist for sales: 1) AWS account ID(s) + VPC CIDRs, 2) preferred topology (PrivateLink vs peering), 3) region for cost estimate, 4) ops contact (SSM allowed?), 5) security contact for endpoint policy and log retention.

nina_sales: Thanks all, I'll send the snippet + tentative cost estimate to AuroraHealth and loop back here with their answers. :thumbsup:
